title: Clearer Skyblock rewards and safer islands
summary: Find your next reward faster, harvest your new island straight away, and keep your builds safe when returning home.
body:
- Claim completed quest rewards directly from the main Skyblock menu. Your island display reminds you when rewards are ready and points to daily or weekly goals after the main quests.
- New islands start with ripe wheat, so you can begin your first harvest immediately. Farming progress now counts ripe crops.
- Returning home preserves your island edits and finds a safe landing. Island animals, containers and decorations have stronger ownership protection.
- Worker upgrades preserve production already earned at the previous rate, and the menus explain storage limits and objective reset times.
- Mobile worker collections and merchant sales advance the same daily and weekly goals as in-game actions. Claiming a mobile objective updates your island level immediately.
